title: PCSO Lotto Results: Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot reaches P299M as no winners of major jackpot draws on September 15
summary: The Ultra Lotto 6/58 prize has now reached close to P300 million after there were no winners of the major lotto jackpot draws on September 15, 2026, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO)…

blocks.text: The Ultra Lotto 6/58 prize has now reached close to P300 million after there were no winners of the major lotto jackpot draws on September 15, 2026, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced on Tuesday.
The Ultra Lotto jackpot now stands at P299,250,664.14 after no bettor played the winning numbers of 53-49-56-01-18-50.
According to the PCSO, the odds of winning the Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot are 1 in 40,475,358 or approximately 0.00000247%.
The last time someone won in Ultra Lotto was March 17 when a senior citizen who played lotto for the past 25 years became the sole winner of P100.331 million.
There were also no correct guesses of the Super Lotto 6/49 lucky combo of 23-42-33-15-14-30. The pot has reached P25,166,446.45.
The Lotto 6/42 numbers of 32-02-05-13-06-27 were left unpicked so no one took home the P41,871,066.69 prize.
